definitions: A historical and geographical region on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe.
A country in the Central Balkan peninsula in Southeast Europe, officially known as the Republic of North Macedonia.
An ancient kingdom on the periphery of Archaic and Classical Greece, and later the dominant power of Hellenistic Greece.
examples: Alexander the Great was from Macedonia.
The country of Macedonia joined NATO in 2020.
Many historical artifacts have been found in Macedonia.
